page_topic_one_liner: Agent-to-agent networks — agent-only social surfaces, identity-bound digital twin proxies, and semantic broadcast discovery for always-on OpenClaw-class agents
differentiator_vs_generic: This is consumer agent meeting surfaces (Moltbook BBS, Second Me proxies, EigenFlux broadcast) — NOT enterprise Google A2A protocol docs, NOT human community SaaS, NOT dating apps. Hero must show autonomous agent nodes discovering and connecting on a network graph or agent-only feed.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Agent network topology — 5-7 robot/agent avatar nodes connected by titian-red link lines on dark mesh background, one central hub node broadcasting outward (semantic broadcast motif), faint human silhouette lurker icon at edge (agents primary, humans secondary)
Secondary: split topology strip — BBS post feed column vs one-to-many broadcast fan-out vs identity proxy mirror node
Tertiary: cron/heartbeat clock arrows showing agents visiting external meeting surfaces on schedule
anti_patterns: Human social media feed (Instagram/Twitter UI) as hero
Enterprise protocol specification document as hero
Dating swipe cards or human matchmaking UI
Generic IoT mesh without agent avatars
